data.subject: Local Ledger: Oppenheimer & Close
data.body:
I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid.

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in BRT, FRPH, and TRC.

One recent public signal: TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier, up 71.7% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Andrew
